observationMethod: Official Microsoft Learn pages inspected with fetch_webpage. Excerpts below are bounded transcriptions of returned text, not complete page snapshots. Hashes identify these local excerpt records, not the remote page or Git tree.
datePolicy: ms.date is a publisher-supplied documentation date, not necessarily initial publication. updated_at is retained as a build/update observation, not proof of substantive change. No product GA claim follows from either field.

sources.title: Application lifecycle management with Microsoft Power Platform
sources.foundationReason: Stable ALM and source-control concepts; official page re-read on observedOn. Older than the nine-month window. User approval is still required.

spans.locator: ALM for Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
spans.quote: Source control should be your source of truth for storing and collaborating on your components.
spans.claim: Use source control as the source of truth for solution components.

spans.locator: ALM for Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
spans.quote: To use the Power Platform features and tools available to manage ALM, all environments that participate in ALM must include a Dataverse database.
spans.claim: The documented Power Platform ALM tooling requires participating environments to include a Dataverse database; this is not a claim that every Power Apps application requires Dataverse.

sources.title: Solution concepts with Power Platform
sources.foundationReason: Managed/unmanaged solution semantics are foundational; page re-read on observedOn. Not evidence of a new feature or approved exception.

spans.quote: Unmanaged solutions are used in development environments while you make changes to your application.
spans.claim: Use unmanaged solutions for development changes.

spans.quote: As an ALM best practice, managed solutions should be generated by exporting an unmanaged solution as managed and considered a build artifact.
spans.claim: Treat the managed solution exported from development as a build artifact for downstream deployment.

spans.quote: When you delete a managed solution, the following data is lost: data stored in custom tables that are part of the managed solution and data stored in custom columns that are part of the managed solution on other tables that aren't part of the managed solution.
spans.claim: Uninstalling managed solutions can lose data; it is not a generally safe rollback strategy.

sources.title: Overview of pipelines in Power Platform

spans.locator: Frequently asked questions / What do pipelines deploy?
spans.quote: Pipelines deploy solutions as well as configuration for the target environment such as connections, connection references, and environment variables.
spans.claim: Pipelines deploy solutions and target-environment configuration, including connection references and environment variables.

spans.locator: Frequently asked questions / What do pipelines deploy?
spans.quote: Pipelines, or solutions in general, don't contain data stored within Dataverse tables.
spans.claim: A solution deployment does not migrate Dataverse table records; plan data migration separately.

spans.quote: Connections and environment variables are provided upfront and validated before the deployment begins.
spans.claim: Resolve target connections and environment variables before deployment; this prevalidation does not prove business correctness.

spans.locator: Frequently asked questions / Can customization bypass a deployment stage such as QA?
spans.quote: The same solution artifact must pass through pipeline stages in sequential order.
spans.claim: The documented pipeline promotes the same solution artifact through sequential stages.

spans.locator: Frequently asked questions / Can pipelines deploy to a different tenant?
spans.quote: No. We recommend using Azure DevOps or GitHub for this scenario.
spans.claim: Built-in pipelines do not provide cross-tenant deployment in the cited documentation; assess another CI/CD path.

spans.locator: Frequently asked questions / Are standalone licenses required to use pipelines?
spans.quote: Licenses granting premium use rights are required for all managed environments.
spans.claim: Validate environment licensing and actual entitlements; do not promise universally free pipeline usage.

sources.title: Use plug-ins to extend business processes

spans.quote: Use plug-ins when a declarative process doesn't meet your requirement.
spans.claim: Evaluate declarative options first; use plug-ins when the requirement warrants code.

spans.quote: This interface exposes a single method called Execute.
spans.claim: The documented IPlugin interface exposes Execute; exact implementation signatures and registration steps need the linked SDK reference before writing code.

spans.quote: A synchronous plug-in causes the data operation to wait until the code in the plug-in finishes.
spans.claim: Synchronous plug-ins delay the data operation; keep work bounded and assess latency.

spans.quote: Asynchronous plug-in execution is queued and runs after the data operation finishes.
spans.claim: Asynchronous plug-ins run after the data operation, so they are not interchangeable with synchronous validation.

spans.quote: Power Platform admin center data policies allow administrators to control access to these connectors in various ways to help reduce risk in your organization.
spans.claim: Data policies provide connector guardrails; this is not a guarantee against all data leakage or a substitute for application security.

spans.quote: For the most extreme cases, the latency for full enforcement is 24 hours. In most cases, it's within an hour.
spans.claim: Do not assume policy changes take effect instantly; validate enforcement in the target environment.

spans.quote: Microsoft permits the use of these icons in architectural diagrams, training materials, or documentation.
spans.claim: Official icons have stated permitted diagram, training, and documentation uses; this is not a general trademark or marketing license.

spans.quote: Don’t crop, flip, or rotate icons
spans.claim: Preserve official icon orientation, shape, and proportions; do not use them as the a2swe logo.
